author: rocklou8s_452
quote: O jogo mais revolucionário já feito. Definiu o mercado e trouxe ao mundo dos videogames as mecânicas que vemos por todas as partes.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: rocklou8s_452
quote: Terrible. A disgrace to the GTA franchise and a disrespect to the fans. A completely empty and soulless game. It's just another money-making scheme built on the blind hype of the fans. Thankfully, the GTA community has been waking up in recent days and starting to realize how disappointing this game was. The critics' score was clearly biased. This game doesn't even deserve to carry the GTA title in its name. Shameful.
